qe: What is the primary physiological function of Platelets (Thrombocytes) in human blood?
qh: मानव रक्त में प्लेटलेट्स (थ्रोम्बोसाइट्स) का प्राथमिक शारीरिक कार्य क्या है?
e: Concept: Blood ke teen main components hote hain - RBC (oxygen dhaane ke liye), WBC (defence ke liye) aur Platelets ya Thrombocytes (chhote cell-fragments). Platelets ka kaam Hemostasis hai - jab blood vessel phat jata hai to platelets us jagah chipak kar ek thakka (clot) banati hain aur blood clotting ka process shuru karte hain, jisse khoon behna band ho jata hai. Baaki teen kaam doosre components karte hain: Oxygen transport RBC (haemoglobin) karta hai, immune phagocytosis WBC karte hain, aur Osmoregulation kidneys karti hain. Exam point: 'Platelets = hemostasis/blood clotting (kam hone par dengue me bleeding)', 'platelets normal count = 1.5-4 lakh per mm3'.

qe: The double-walled fibroserous sac that encloses and protects the human heart is called the:
qh: मानव हृदय को घेरने और सुरक्षित रखने वाली दोहरी झिल्लीदार थैली को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Heart ke chaaron taraf ek do-paraton (double-walled) thaili hoti hai jise Pericardium kehte hain - bahar wali parat fibrous (mazboot) hoti hai aur andar wali serous, jiske dono layer ke beech 'pericardial fluid' bhara hota hai. Ye fluid heart ko friction aur jhatkon (shock) se bachata hai, aur sac heart ko fixed jagah par rakhta hai. Baaki teen doosre organs ke covering hain: Peritoneum pet ki gufa ka, Meninges brain-spine ka, aur Pleura lungs ka. Exam point: 'Heart ka cover = Pericardium', 'Lungs = Pleura', 'Brain = Meninges', 'Pet = Peritoneum'.

qe: Which surgical procedure revascularizes myocardium by routing blood around obstructed coronary arteries using vascular grafts?
qh: अवरुद्ध कोरोनरी धमनी के चारों ओर रक्त प्रवाह के लिए संवहनी ग्राफ्ट जोड़कर नया रास्ता बनाने वाली सर्जरी कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Jab coronary artery me chikna padarth (plaque) jama hokar block ho jati hai to heart ke muscle ko blood kam milta hai (angina/heart attack). CABG (Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting) me patient ki hi taang ya chest ki vein/artery (graft) lekar blocked hisse ke aage-peeche ek naya rasta (bypass) banaya jata hai, taaki blood us raste se pahunch kar myocardial ko oxygen de. Baaki teen alag procedures hain: Angiography sirf block ka photo/test hai (ilaaj nahi), Cardiac ablation dharkan ki galti wale raste jalata hai, aur Hemodialysis kidney failure ke patients ka khoon saaf karta hai. Exam point: 'Heart ka bypass = CABG'.

qe: Ringer's Lactate (RL) intravenous solution is primarily indicated in clinical medicine for:
qh: रिंगर लैक्टेट (RL) अंतःशिरा घोल मुख्य रूप से किन रोगियों को इलेक्ट्रोलाइट्स संतुलित करने हेतु दिया जाता है?
o: Hypovolemic fluid resuscitation and electrolyte restoration
e: Concept: Ringer's Lactate (RL) ek balanced IV fluid hai jisme sodium, potassium, calcium, chloride aur lactate bhare hote hain - iski composition blood plasma ke kareeb hoti hai. Isliye jab kisi patient me khoon ya paani ki bahut kami ho jaye (accident, burns, diarrhea, surgery) to Hypovolemic fluid resuscitation aur electrolytes ki bharpai ke liye RL chadaya jata hai. Baaki teen me ye use nahi hota: Hyperkalemia (K+ zyada) me to K wala fluid bahut khatarnak hai, Hyperglycemia me glucose wala fluid, aur eye infection (conjunctivitis) me drops. Exam point: 'RL = accident/burns me fluid resuscitation (plasma-jaisa balanced solution)'.

qe: Which heart chamber possesses the thickest myocardium to overcome high systemic vascular resistance?
qh: हृदय के किस कक्ष की मांसपेशी दीवार सबसे मोटी होती है ताकि वह पूरे शरीर में रक्त पंप कर सके?
e: Concept: Heart me 4 chambers hote hain aur unki wall ki motai kaam ke hisaab se hoti hai - jitni door khoon bhejna hota hai, utni moti wall. Left ventricle ko pure sharir (systemic circulation) me blood pump karna hota hai, jahan blood vessels ka resistance sabse zyada hai, isliye iski myocardium sabse moti (thickest) hoti hai. Right ventricle sirf lungs me pump karta hai (kam pressure), aur atria me to bas blood collect hota hai, isliye unki wall patli hoti hai. Exam point: 'Thickest myocardium = Left Ventricle (unke liye BP 120/80 ka 120 systole isi ka kaam hai)'.

qe: A drastic, life-threatening drop in platelet count (Thrombocytopenia) is classically associated with which viral illness?
qh: प्लेटलेट काउंट में अचानक और गंभीर गिरावट (थ्रोम्बोसाइटोपेनिया) किस वायरल बीमारी का मुख्य लक्षण है?
e: Concept: Platelets (thrombocytes) ki normal maatra 1.5-4 lakh/mm3 hoti hai; jab ye tezi se gir jati hai to 'Thrombocytopenia' kehte hain aur sharir me khoon na jamne se bleeding shuru ho jati hai. Dengue virus platelet ka khaas dushman hai - wo bone marrow par aur platelets par attack karta hai, isliye dengue me platelets gir jati hain aur bleeding (petechiae, gum bleeding) dikhti hai. Baaki teen se aisi platelet kami nahi hoti: Tuberculosis (bacteria), Malaria (parasite jo RBC todta hai), aur Cholera (diarrhea/dehydration). Exam point: 'Dengue = platelet drop (thrombocytopenia)', 'typhoid = Widal test'.

qe: Which rapid point-of-care diagnostic test assesses arterial blood pH, PaO2, PaCO2, and electrolytes in critical care?
qh: क्रिटिकल केयर में धमनी रक्त के pH, ऑक्सीजन, कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड और इलेक्ट्रोलाइट्स की त्वरित पुष्टि कौन सा टेस्ट करता है?
e: Concept: ABG (Arterial Blood Gas) ek aisi post-of-care test hai jisme artery se thoda khoon le kar usme pH, PaCO2, PaO2 aur electrolytes (jaise Na+, K+, HCO3-) dekhe jate hain - isse pata chalta hai ki patient sirf thik se saans le raha hai, blood me oxygen kitni hai aur acid-base balance theek hai ya nahi. ICU me safar aur saans ki bimariyon (COPD, asthma) me ye lifesaving test hai. Baaki teen alag tests hain: Lipid profile me cholesterol/triglyceride, CBC me cell counts, aur Widal me typhoid. Exam point: 'Saans + acid-base = ABG (pH, PaO2, PaCO2)'.

qe: Severe disturbances in systemic Potassium (K+) levels primarily precipitate fatal complications in which organ?
qh: शरीर में पोटेशियम (K+) का असंतुलन मुख्य रूप से किस अंग की विद्युत कार्यप्रणाली को प्रभावित कर घातक सिद्ध हो सकता है?
e: Concept: Potassium (K+) electrolyte hi dil ki dhadkan ke liye sabse sensitive hai - iska normal level 3.5-5.0 mEq/L hota hai. K+ kam (hypokalemia) ya zyada (hyperkalemia) hone par heart ke electrical signal bigad jate hain: pehle ECG me change dikhta hai (T-wave), phir dangerous arrhythmia (VF/asystole) aa sakta hai aur dil ruk sakta hai - isliye kidney fail patients me K+ ka level sabse pehle dekhte hain. Baaki teen organs K+ ke is sudden badlaav se turant nahi rukte: Lungs, Skin aur Kidneys gradual affect hote hain. Exam point: 'K+ ka electrical effect sabse zyada Heart par (hyperkalemia = cardiac arrest ka khaas kaaran)'.

qe: The Plasmodium malaria parasite primarily invades, multiplies within, and ruptures which human host cells?
qh: मलेरिया परजीवी (प्लास्मोडियम) मुख्य रूप से किन कोशिकाओं और अंग पर हमला कर क्षति पहुँचाता है?
e: Concept: Malaria ke Plasmodium parasite ka ek khaas life-cycle hai: mosquito ke kaatne par ye pehle liver me jata hai, wahan se bahar aakar Red Blood Cells (RBC) me ghusta hai, andar badhta hai (multiply karta hai) aur RBC ko phod deta hai - isi wajah se har 48-72 ghante me bukhar ka 'cycle' aata hai (thand, bukhar, paseena) aur anaemia hoti hai. Spleen bhi badhta hai (splenomegaly) kyunki wo parasite wale RBC hataata hai. Baaki teen cells me ye parasite nahi ghusta: Cardiac myocytes (heart), Alveolar macrophages (lungs), Glomerular podocytes (kidney). Exam point: 'Malaria = RBC + spleen', 'sabse khatarnak = P. falciparum (cerebral malaria)'.

qe: Fat-soluble Vitamin K is indispensable for the hepatic post-translational carboxylation of which clotting factors?
qh: विटामिन K यकृत में किन रक्त-स्कंदन (क्लॉटिंग) कारकों के संश्लेषण के लिए अनिवार्य है?
o: Factors II, VII, IX, and X
e: Concept: Vitamin K ek fat-soluble vitamin hai jo liver me clotting factors ki post-translational carboxylation (i.e. khaas 'useful' form banane) ke liye zaroori hai. Clotting me 4 aise factors hain jo Vitamin K par depend karte hain: Factor II (prothrombin), VII, IX aur X - inhe 'Vitamin K-dependent factors' kehte hain. Isi liye Vitamin K ki kami se bleeding tendency hoti hai aur Vitamin K ka injection (ya antidote) warfarin overdose me diya jata hai. Baaki teen factors Vitamin K par nirbhar nahi hain: VIII, XI, XII, XIII, I (fibrinogen) aur V. Exam point: 'Vitamin K = Factors II, VII, IX, X yaad rakho: 1972 = factor 2, 7, 9, 10'.

qe: Which organ filters out senescent erythrocytes and acts as an emergency red blood cell reservoir?
qh: कौन सा अंग पुराने या क्षतिग्रस्त RBC को छानकर नष्ट करता है और 'आरबीसी का कब्रिस्तान व ब्लड बैंक' कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Spleen (pleeha) blood ka 'filter' aur RBC ka 'kabristan' hai - ye purane/naakara (senescent) RBC ko hatata hai aur unka iron recycle karta hai; ye emergency me blood reserve (khaas kar RBC) ka godown bhi hai, isliye accident me spleen sikud kar bache khoon ko circulation me daal deta hai. Baaki teen organs ye kaam nahi karte: Pancreas digestion aur insulin, Thymus T-lymphocytes ki training, aur Liver detox aur protein banata hai (purane RBC ka main filter wo nahi hai). Exam point: 'Purane RBC ka filter = Spleen (isme blood reserve bhi hota hai)'.

qe: During the physiological 'Fight or Flight' acute stress response, blood pressure and heart rate are elevated by:
qh: आपातकालीन 'करो या मरो' प्रतिक्रिया में हृदय गति और रक्तचाप को तेजी से बढ़ाने वाला हार्मोन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: 'Fight or flight' emergency response me adrenal gland ka medulla Adrenaline (epinephrine) chhodta hai - ye hormone heart rate aur blood pressure badhata hai, breathing tez karta hai, aankh ki puppli (pupil) failata hai aur muscle/lever ko glucose deta hai, taaki sharir ladne ya bhaagne ke liye taiyar ho jaye. Baaki teen alag hormones hain: Insulin blood sugar kam karta hai, Calcitonin calcium ko haddi me bharta hai, aur Melatonin neend ka hormone hai. Exam point: 'Emergency/fight-or-flight = Adrenaline (epinephrine) - heart rate + BP badhata hai'.

qe: What is the typical physiological lifespan of an enucleated human Red Blood Cell (Erythrocyte)?
qh: एक परिपक्व केंद्रकहीन मानव लाल रक्त कोशिका (RBC) का औसत जीवनकाल कितने दिनों का होता है?
e: Concept: RBC (erythrocyte) mature hone par apna nucleus aur mitochondria kho deta hai - isse uske andar haemoglobin ke liye zyada jagah banti hai (oxygen dhaane ki kshamta badhti hai), par isi wajah se wo reproduce aur repair bhi nahi kar sakta. Isliye RBC ki umar limited hoti hai, takriban 120 din; uske baad spleen/liver os purane RBC ko tod dete hain aur unka iron dobara use hota hai. Baaki teen durations galat hain: 7-10 din platelets ki umar hai, 30 din aur 365 din kisi normal blood cell ki nahi. Exam point: 'RBC ki umar = 120 din', 'Platelets = 7-10 din', 'WBC = kuch ghante se kuch din'.

qe: ABO blood grouping identity is determined by the specific polymorphic oligosaccharide antigens located on the:
qh: मानव ABO रक्त समूहों का वर्गीकरण किसकी सतह पर पाए जाने वाले विशिष्ट एंटीजन के आधार पर किया जाता है?
e: Concept: ABO blood group ka faisla RBC ke upar maujood sugars (antigens) se hota hai - Group A wale par A-antigen, B par B-antigen, aur AB par dono. Ye antigens RBC ki plasma membrane par maujood hote hain, isliye testing me sirf blood cells par dekhe jate hain. Baaki teen galat hain: Blood plasma me antibodies hote hain (antigens nahi), neutrophil granules aur platelet membrane par ABO antigens nahi hote. Exam point: 'ABO antigens = RBC ki membrane par; antibodies = plasma me' - ye sabse common confuse point hai.

qe: Which blood plasma antibodies are naturally synthesized by an individual with phenotypic Blood Group 'A'?
qh: ब्लड ग्रुप 'A' वाले व्यक्ति के रक्त प्लाज्मा में कौन सी प्राकृतिक एंटीबॉडी मौजूद होती है?
e: Concept: Blood Group A wale insaan ke RBC par 'A' antigen hota hai; sharir ke immune system ki simple policy hai - 'jo apne paas hai uske khilaf antibody mat banao'. Isliye Group A wale ka plasma Anti-B antibody banata hai (B ko dushman samajhta hai), par Anti-A nahi. Baaki teen options galat hain: Anti-A antibody Group B ya O wale banate hain, dono antibodies O wale me hote hain, aur koi antibody nahi AB wale me hota hai. Exam point: 'A -> anti-B', 'B -> anti-A', 'AB -> koi nahi (universal recipient)', 'O -> dono (universal donor)'.

qe: Why is Blood Group 'O-negative' universally transfused to emergency trauma victims with unknown typing?
qh: आपात स्थिति में बिना मिलान के 'O-नेगेटिव' रक्त को सर्वदाता (Universal Donor) के रूप में क्यों दिया जा सकता है?
o: It lacks A, B, and Rh (D) surface antigens
It contains high synthetic clotting factors
e: Concept: O-negative blood ko 'universal donor' kehte hain kyunki iske RBC par teeno khaas antigens nahi hote - na A, na B, na Rh (D). Isliye emergency me jab patient ka blood group pata nahi hota, O-negative blood dene se recipient ke plasma me koi antibody usse chhipak kar destroy nahi karta (transfusion reaction ka khatra sabse kam). Baaki teen options galat hain: isme clotting factors zyada nahi hote, antibody titers bhi kam hote hain (max nahi), aur ye plaques ghol nahi sakta. Exam point: 'Universal donor RBC = O-negative; Universal recipient = AB-positive'.

qe: Which blood group phenotype acts as the universal recipient of RBCs because its plasma lacks ABO/Rh isoantibodies?
qh: कौन सा रक्त समूह 'सर्वग्राही' (Universal Recipient) कहलाता है क्योंकि इसके प्लाज्मा में A, B या Rh एंटीबॉडी नहीं होती?
e: Concept: AB-positive blood group ko 'universal recipient' kehte hain - kyunki iske plasma me na Anti-A, na Anti-B aur na Anti-Rh antibodies hote hain (uska sharir teeno antigens ko apna maanta hai). Isliye ise kisi bhi group ka blood chadha sakte hain, sharir use destroy nahi karega. Baaki teen groups antibodies rakhte hain: B-positive me anti-A, O-positive me dono ABO antibodies, aur A-negative me anti-B aur anti-Rh. Exam point: 'Universal recipient = AB-positive', 'Universal donor = O-negative'.

qe: The primate erythrocyte agglutinogen termed the 'Rh Factor' was discovered by Landsteiner and Wiener in 1940 using:
qh: 1940 में लैंडस्टीनर और विनर द्वारा 'Rh फैक्टर' की खोज सबसे पहले किस प्राणी के रक्त में की गई थी?
e: Concept: Rh factor ek RBC antigen hai jise 1940 me Landsteiner aur Wiener ne khoja tha - unhone chimpanzee/monkey nahi, Rhesus macaque bandaron ke blood se ise dhoondha, isliye naam 'Rh' (Rhesus) pada. Ye factor ~85% logon me hota hai (Rh-positive) aur baaki me nahi (Rh-negative). Baaki teen bandar prajatiyan yahan nahi thi: canine (kutta), murine (chuha), feline (billi). Exam point: 'Rh factor = Rhesus macaque monkey se khoj (1940, Landsteiner & Wiener)'.

qe: The tightly regulated physiological pH range of healthy human systemic arterial blood is:
qh: स्वस्थ मानव शरीर के धमनी रक्त का नियंत्रित सामान्य pH मान कितना होता है?
e: Concept: Blood ka pH bahut narrow range me strictly controlled rehta hai - 7.35 se 7.45 (thoda alkaline). Ye balance enzymes aur protein ke kaam ke liye zaroori hai; pH 7.35 se neeche giraye to 'acidosis' hota hai (CO2 ya acid badhna, jaise diabetes/breathing problems me) aur 7.45 se upar jaye to 'alkalosis' (vomiting, hyperventilation me). Baaki teen ranges zinda insaan ke blood ke liye namumkin hain: 5.5-6.2, 6.8-6.95 (ye buttermilk/vinegar jaisa) aur 7.8-8.0 (ye alkaline household product jaisa). Exam point: 'Blood pH = 7.35-7.45 (slightly alkaline)'.

qe: In a developing human fetus, hematopoiesis (blood cell production) prior to definitive bone formation occurs in the:
qh: अस्थि मज्जा के पूर्ण विकास से पहले मानव भ्रूण (Fetus) में रक्त कोशिकाओं का निर्माण कहाँ होता है?
e: Concept: Fetus ke development me blood banane ki jagah badalti rehti hai: pehle yolk sac (~3 hafte), phir liver aur spleen (~2-5 month, jab haddiyan ban rahi hoti hain), aur aakhri mahino me bone marrow. Isliye jab tak definitive bone formation nahi hoti, fetus ka hemopoiesis (RBC-WBC banane ka kaam) Liver and Spleen me hota hai - isi liye liver ko fetal life ka 'main blood factory' kehte hain. Baaki teen organs is kaam me nahi aate: Adrenal, Thyroid aur Placental cotyledons. Exam point: 'Fetus me blood banane ka pehla bada organ = Liver (baad me bone marrow)'.

qe: What is the biological definition of 'Serum' in diagnostic laboratory hematology?
qh: चिकित्सा जांच की भाषा में 'सीरम' (Serum) की सटीक परिभाषा क्या है?
o: Blood plasma minus fibrinogen and clotting factors
e: Concept: Blood ko jab clotting rokne wala factor (anticoagulant) daal kar-clot na hone wala taral bana lete hain to us dravya ko plasma kehte hain; aur jab clotting (clot) banana allow karke clot ko alag kar dete hain, to bachi hui peeli-taral ko Serum kehte hain. Yaani Serum = plasma minus fibrinogen aur clotting factors - isliye serum me ab bhi albumin, globulin, hormones, antibodies sab hote hain, par fibrinogen nahi. Baaki teen definitions galat hain: whole blood minus RBC ko hi plasma nahi kehte, hemolyzed leukocyte aur concentrated lymph alag cheezein hain. Exam point: 'Serum = Plasma - clotting factors (clinical laboratory tests isi par hote hain)'.

qe: Which endogenous sulfated glycosaminoglycan prevents spontaneous thrombosis within intact vascular endothelium?
qh: स्वस्थ रक्त वाहिकाओं के भीतर रक्त को जमने से रोकने वाला प्राकृतिक एंटी-कोअगुलेंट कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Heparin ek natural anticoagulant hai jo sharir me mast cells aur basophils banate hain (aur hospital me iska injection blood patla karne ke liye lagta hai). Ye ek sulfated glycosaminoglycan hai jo thrombin aur antithrombin-3 se judkar clotting process ko rok deta hai - isi liye intact endothelium (saaf blood vessel ki andar ki parat) par khud ka khoon jam nahi jata. Baaki teen coagulation-related proteins/alag hain: Fibrinogen clot ka kaccha material, Prothrombin aur Thrombin clotting enzymes (clot banao, rok nahi). Exam point: 'Sharir ka natural anticoagulant aur hospital ka blood-thinner = Heparin'.

qe: What is the primary function of the specialized peripheral Lymph Nodes distributed along lymphatic vessels?
qh: लसिका वाहिकाओं के साथ स्थित 'लसिका गांठों' (Lymph Nodes) का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
o: Active filtration of pathogens and immune cell presentation
e: Concept: Lymph nodes chhoti rajai (bean) jaisi banawat hain jo poori body me lymph vessels ke raste par phaili hoti hain. Inka kaam do guna hai: (1) lymph ko filter karna - usme aa gaye bacteria, virus, cancer cells ko rokna, aur (2) immune cells (lymphocytes, macrophages) ko pathogen ke saamne pesh karke antibody/immunity ka jawab shuru karna. Isliye infection me nodes soojh jate hain (jaise gale/tonsil ke paas). Baaki teen kaam nahi karte: Erythropoietin kidney banati hai, lymph ko aage badhana bade vessels aur muscles karte hain, aur starch ki paachan aanto me hoti hai. Exam point: 'Lymph node = filter + immune checkpoint (soojhna = infection ka lakshan)'.

qe: Microscopic capillaries represent the critical connecting links between the arterial and venous trees because they:
qh: धमनियों और शिराओं के बीच की सूक्ष्म 'केशिकाएं' (Capillaries) सबसे महत्वपूर्ण क्यों हैं?
o: Provide single-cell endothelial barriers for gas and nutrient diffusion
e: Concept: Capillary (keshika) sabse chhoti blood vessels hain, jinki wall sirf ek cell moti (single-cell endothelial layer) hoti hai - itni patli ki oxygen, CO2, glucose, salts sab aasani se blood aur tissue ke beech aage-peeche ja sakte hain (diffusion). Yahi dhaan hi unhe artery aur vein ke beech 'critical link' banata hai, aur yahin actual delivery hoti hai. Baaki teen galat hain: valves capillaries me nahi hote (wo veins me hote hain), reserve pool yahan nahi hota (spleen me), aur systolic pressure arteries me banta hai. Exam point: 'Gas/nutrient exchange = capillaries (ek-cell moti wall)'.

qe: Venous blood vessels possess internal bicuspid endothelial pocket valves predominantly to:
qh: शिराओं में कपाट (Valves) क्यों मौजूद होते हैं जबकि धमनियों में नहीं?
o: Prevent gravitational retrograde backflow under low-pressure conditions
Accelerate blood velocity above systolic thresholds
e: Concept: Veins (shira) me blood ka pressure bahut kam hota hai, aur khaas kar taangon ki veins ko blood ko heart tak ulta (upward) bhejna padta hai - gravity usse peeche khinchti hai. Iske liye veins me bicuspid pocket valves (chhote darwaaze) hote hain jo blood ko sirf ek taraf (heart ki taraf) jaane dete hain aur wapas girne nahi dete; muscles ka dabav bhi blood ko aage dhaakta hai. Baaki teen kaam valves nahi karte: lipids filter karna, blood velocity badhana (capillaries me wo sabse kam hoti hai), aur RBC me oxygen bharna. Exam point: 'Veins ke valves = blood ko wapas girne se rokna (varicose veins me ye fail ho jate hain)'.

qe: What instrument is clinically deployed to auscultate and measure systemic arterial systolic and diastolic blood pressure?
qh: धमनियों में सिस्टोलिक और डायस्टोलिक रक्तचाप मापने के लिए किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Blood pressure naapne ke liye sphygmomanometer use hota hai - isme ek cuff (patte wali peti) hoti hai jise haath par bandhte hain aur usme hawa bharte-phoolte hain, aur ek mercury ya digital dial par pressure padh lete hain. Systolic (upar ki sankhya) aur diastolic (neeche ki sankhya) dono isi se milte hain. Baaki teen alag instruments hain: EEG brain ki electrical waves, Spirometer saans ki capacity, aur Goniometer kone/joint ka angle. Exam point: 'BP ka instrument = Sphygmomanometer (normal 120/80 mmHg)'.

qe: The Tricuspid atrioventricular valve is anatomically positioned between which two chambers of the human heart?
qh: मानव हृदय में ट्राइकस्पिड वाल्व (Tricuspid Valve) किन दो कक्षों के बीच स्थित होता है?
e: Concept: Heart me do atrioventricular (AV) valves hote hain jo atria aur ventricles ke beech gate ki tarah kaam karte hain. Dayein taraf (right) wala valve Triticuspid (tri = teen) kehlata hai kyunki usme teen pattiyaan (cusps) hoti hain, aur ye Right Atrium aur Right Ventricle ke beech lagta hai. Baaki teen jodiyan doosri jagah hain: Right Ventricle-Pulmonary trunk (pulmonary valve), Left Ventricle-Aorta (aortic valve) aur Left Atrium-Left Ventricle (mitral valve). Exam point: 'Tricuspid = Right side (3 pattiyaan)', 'Mitral/Bicuspid = Left side (2 pattiyaan)'.

qe: The Bicuspid (Mitral) valve guards the atrioventricular orifice located between the:
qh: मिट्रल वाल्व (बाइकस्पिड वाल्व) किन दो कक्षों के बीच रक्त के विपरीत प्रवाह को रोकता है?
o: Right Atrium and Inferior Vena Cava
e: Concept: Bicuspid (Mitral) valve heart ke left side ka atrioventricular valve hai jo Left Atrium aur Left Ventricle ke beech lagta hai - isme do (bi) pattiyaan hoti hain, isliye naam Bicuspid; kyunki dikhne me bishop ki topi (mitre) jaisa lagta hai, isliye Mitral bhi kehte hain. Ye oxygenated blood ko left atrium se left ventricle me jaane deta hai aur wapas na aane deta hai. Baaki teen jodiyan alag hain: Left Ventricle-Right Ventricle (aise connection nahi hota), Right Atrium-Vena Cava (koi valve), Right Ventricle-Lungs (pulmonary valve). Exam point: 'Mitral/Bicuspid = Left side (2 pattiyaan)'.

qe: Which blood vessels branch off the root of the ascending aorta to supply oxygenated blood directly to myocardium?
qh: हृदय की अपनी मांसपेशियों को ऑक्सीजन युक्त रक्त पहुँचाने वाली धमनियां क्या कहलाती हैं?
e: Concept: Heart khud bhi ek muscle hai, isliye usko apna blood chahiye - aur ye blood ascending aorta ki jad se nikalti hui Coronary arteries deti hain; ye do arteries (left aur right) heart ke muscle ke ardish ki taraf phailti hain. Jab inme block ho jata hai to 'coronary artery disease'/heart attack hota hai. Baaki teen arteries sharir ke doosre hisson ke liye hain: Carotid (brain), Mesenteric (aanto), Subclavian (haath/kandha). Exam point: 'Heart ka apna blood supply = Coronary arteries (aorta ke root se)'.

qe: An expandable endovascular wire-mesh tube permanently deployed to maintain patency in a stenotic artery is a:
qh: अवरुद्ध धमनी को खुला रखने के लिए एंजियोप्लास्टी के दौरान लगाई जाने वाली जालीदार नली को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Concept: Jab kisi artery me plaque se raasta patla (stenotic) ho jata hai, to angioplasty me ek balloon se jagah khol kar wahan ek expandable mesh tube (wire-mesh) daal di jati hai, jo permanently wahan reh kar artery ko khula rakhti hai. Is mesh tube ko Intravascular Stent kehte hain; kuch stents me dawa (drug-eluting) bhi hoti hai taaki dobara block na bane. Baaki teen alag things hain: Catheter ek patli naali (rasta banane ke liye), Pacemaker dharkan ko control karne wala electrical device, aur Dialyzer kidney ka artificial filter. Exam point: 'Artery khuli rakhne wala mesh tube = Stent'.

qe: The specialized neuromuscular tissue termed the primary 'Natural Pacemaker' of the mammalian heart is the:
qh: हृदय की प्राकृतिक धड़कन के लिए विद्युत आवेग उत्पन्न करने वाला 'प्राकृतिक पेसमेकर' कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Heart ka apna electrical system hai jisme ek chhota se group of cells apne aap (auto) impulse banata hai - ise Sinoatrial (SA) Node kehte hain, jo right atrium ki deewar me hota hai. Ye har second me spontaneous depolarize hota hai aur isi se poori dharkan ka rhythm banata hai, isliye ise 'Natural Pacemaker' kehte hain (~70-75 bpm). Baaki teen uske aage ke conductive parts hain: AV Node (impulse ko ventricles tak dhaata hai), Bundle of His aur Purkinje network (poore ventricle me phailate hain) - ye khud impulse nahi banate. Exam point: 'Natural pacemaker = SA Node', 'AV node = gate/delayer'.

qe: Which arterial vessel represents the sole anatomical artery in the adult human body transporting deoxygenated blood?
qh: वयस्क मानव शरीर की एकमात्र ऐसी धमनी कौन सी है जो अशुद्ध (ऑक्सीजन-रहित) रक्त ले जाती है?
e: Concept: Normal niyam hai - arteries pure (oxygenated) blood le jaati hain aur veins kaala (deoxygenated) laati hain; par isse ek apvaad hai: Pulmonary Artery pure kaale khoon ko right ventricle se lungs tak le jaati hai, kyunki lungs me hi usko oxygen milti hai. Isliye pulmonary artery hi adult human body ki ek aisi artery hai jo deoxygenated blood dhaati hai. Baaki teen arteries oxygenated blood dhaati hain: Renal (kidney), Internal carotid (brain) aur Systemic aorta. Exam point: 'Deoxygenated blood wali artery = Pulmonary artery'.

qe: Which vascular channel constitutes the only vein in the human body carrying freshly oxygenated blood?
qh: मानव शरीर की एकमात्र ऐसी शिरा कौन सी है जो शुद्ध (ऑक्सीजन युक्त) रक्त को फेफड़ों से हृदय में लाती है?
e: Concept: Veins ka normal kaam kaala (deoxygenated) blood laana hai, par is is niyam ka ek apvaad Pulmonary Vein hai - ye lungs me oxygen se bharkar laal hue blood ko left atrium me laati hai, isliye ye duniya ki woh ek vein hai jo freshly oxygenated blood dhaati hai. Baaki teen veins kaale blood wali hain: Superior vena cava (upar ke sharir se), Hepatic portal vein (aanto se liver ko) aur Femoral vein (taang se). Exam point: 'Oxygenated blood wali vein = Pulmonary vein' - ye apvaad exam me baar-baar aata hai.

qe: Who first published a complete, mathematically verified description of systemic blood circulation in 1628?
qh: 1628 में मानव रक्त परिसंचरण तंत्र (Circulatory System) की सटीक वैज्ञानिक खोज किसने की थी?
e: Concept: 1628 me English doctor William Harvey ne apni kitaab 'De Motu Cordis' me pehli baar scientifically sabit kiya ki blood ka circulation ek closed loop me hota hai - heart pump karta hai aur blood arteries se ja kar veins ke through wapas aata hai, aur ye process mathematically verify ho sakti hai. Isliye Harvey ko 'Father of Modern Physiology/Circulation' kehte hain. Baaki teen purane scientists hain: Galen ka model galat tha (blood naliyon me aata-jaata hai), Vesalius anatomy ke, aur Malpighi ne capillaries dekhe (1661, Harvey ke baad). Exam point: 'Blood circulation (1628) = William Harvey'.

qe: The audible first heart sound 'Lubb' (S1) is produced by the acoustic vibration accompanying the closure of:
qh: स्टेथोस्कोप से सुनाई देने वाली पहली हृदय ध्वनि 'लव' (S1) किसके बंद होने से उत्पन्न होती है?
e: Concept: Dharkan ki aawaz stethoscope se do sounds me sunai jati hai - pehli 'Lubb' (S1), jo tab hoti hai jab ventricles sikudte hain aur Atrioventricular valves (Tricuspid + Mitral) band hote hain, taaki blood atria me wapas na jaye. Baaki teen events alag sound ke hain: Semilunar valves (Aortic + Pulmonary) ke band hone se doosri aawaz 'Dupp' (S2) hoti hai, aur vena caval orifices/coronary sinus sphincter se koi heart sound nahi banti. Exam point: 'S1 (Lubb) = AV valves (mitral + tricuspid) band', 'S2 (Dupp) = semilunar valves band'.

qe: The second heart sound 'Dupp' (S2) corresponds chronologically to the closure of the:
qh: दूसरी हृदय ध्वनि 'डब' (S2) किस कपाट (Valve) के बंद होने से संबंधित है?
e: Concept: Dharkan ki doosri aawaz 'Dupp' (S2) tab hoti hai jab ventricles relax hone lagte hain aur Semilunar valves (Aortic aur Pulmonary) band hote hain - ye blood ko wapas heart me aane se rokte hain; ye systole ke ant me hota hai. Baaki teen valves ye sound nahi banate: Thebesian valve coronary sinus par, Eustachian valve vena cava par (ye dono chhote remnants hain), aur Atrioventricular valves (in se S1 'Lubb' banti hai). Exam point: 'S2/Dupp = semilunar (aortic + pulmonary) valves ke band hone ki aawaz'.

qe: What is the volume of blood ejected by each ventricle during a single mechanical cardiac contraction (Stroke Volume)?
qh: हृदय के प्रत्येक संकुचन में एक निलय (Ventricle) द्वारा पंप किए जाने वाले रक्त की सामान्य मात्रा (स्ट्रोक वॉल्यूम) कितनी होती है?
e: Concept: Ek contraction (heartbeat) me har ventricle jitna blood bahar pump karta hai use Stroke Volume kehte hain - ek sehatmand adult me ye takriban 70 ml hota hai (64-75 ml range). Isi tarah ek dharkan me dono ventricle milkar ~140 ml khoon bahar bhejte hain. Baaki teen numbers galat hain: 20-30 ml bahut kam, 150-200 ml bahut zyada (ye stroke volume ka dubla hai), aur 500 ml kidney ka ek beat wala plasma flow jaisa number hai. Exam point: 'Stroke volume = ~70 ml', 'Cardiac output = Stroke volume x Heart rate (~5 L/min)'.

qe: Cardiac Output (CO) in an adult at rest is mathematically defined by which equation?
qh: विश्राम अवस्था में कार्डियक आउटपुट (Cardiac Output) का मान किस गणितीय सूत्र द्वारा निकाला जाता है?
o: Stroke Volume multiplied by Heart Rate
Blood Pressure divided by Heart Rate
e: Concept: Cardiac Output (CO) batata hai ki ek minute me heart kitna khoon sharir me bhejta hai. Iska formula simple hai: CO = Stroke Volume (ek dharkan me kitna pump hua) x Heart Rate (ek minute me kitni dharkanein hui). Normal rest par: 70 ml x 72 = takriban 5 litre per minute. Baaki teen formulas galat hain: 'systolic - diastolic' pulse pressure deta hai, End-Diastolic Volume/BSA koi standard formula nahi hai, aur BP/Heart rate ka koi clinical matlab nahi. Exam point: 'CO = SV x HR (~5 L/min rest me)'.

qe: Which major plasma protein synthesized by hepatocytes is chiefly responsible for vascular Colloid Osmotic Pressure?
qh: रक्त वाहिकाओं के भीतर ऑस्मोटिक दबाव (Oncotic Pressure) बनाए रखने और सूजन (Edema) रोकने वाला मुख्य प्लाज्मा प्रोटीन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Plasma me sabse zyada (about 55-60%) protein Serum Albumin hota hai, jo liver (hepatocytes) banata hai. Albumin ke molecules blood me 'colloid osmotic pressure' (oncotic pressure) banate hain, jo paani ko naliyon ke andar rokta hai - isliye albumin kam hone par (liver/kidney disease me) paani tissue me nikal kar sujan (edema) paida karta hai. Baaki teen plasma proteins alag kaam karte hain: Alpha-globulin kuch cheezein dhaata hai, Prothrombin aur Fibrinogen clotting me lagte hain. Exam point: 'Colloid osmotic pressure = Albumin (liver me banta hai)'.

qe: Which transitional state of human erythrocytes is biologically unique among mammalian somatic cells?
qh: परिपक्व मानव लाल रक्त कोशिका (RBC) की कौन सी जैविक विशेषता उसे अन्य कोशिकाओं से अलग बनाती है?
o: Complete absence of nucleus and mitochondria
e: Concept: Mature human RBC ki sabse khaas baat hai - isme nucleus aur mitochondria dono nahi hote (enucleated). Iska fayda: haemoglobin ke liye zyada jagah, aur mitochondria na hone se ye khud apni oxygen kharch nahi karta (anaerobic glycolysis se energy leta hai) - isliye laaye hue oxygen ka bharosa rakhta hai. Baaki teen options RBC me nahi hote: continuous mitosis to nahi hoti (nucleus hi nahi), flagella nahi (wo sperm me hote hain), aur multiple nuclei nahi. Exam point: 'RBC = bina nucleus + bina mitochondria (isliye 120 din jeeta hai)'.

qe: Which granulocytic leukocytes constitute the most abundant fraction (60-70%) of total WBC counts in human peripheral blood?
qh: मानव रक्त में सबसे अधिक संख्या में पाए जाने वाले श्वेत रक्त कण (WBC) कौन से हैं जो संक्रमण में सबसे पहले प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं?
e: Concept: WBC ki total count me neutrophils sabse zyada (60-70%) hote hain - ye body ke 'first responder' hain jo bacteria wali jagah sabse pehle pahunchte hain aur unhe kha (phagocytose) jate hain; isliye pus (peep) me sabse zyada neutrophils hote hain. Baaki teen counts kam hote hain: Eosinophils 2-4%, Monocytes 2-8%, aur Basophils sabse kam (0.5-1%). Exam point: 'WBC me sabse zyada = Neutrophils (60-70%)', 'sabse kam = Basophils', 'sabse bada = Monocytes'.

qe: Which specialized leukocytes differentiate into plasma cells to synthesize and secrete humoral antibodies?
qh: एंटीबॉडी (Antibodies) का उत्पादन और स्राव करने वाली प्रतिरक्षा कोशिकाएं कौन सी हैं?
e: Concept: Lymphocyte do tarah ke hote hain - B-lymphocytes aur T-lymphocytes. Jab B-lymphocyte kisi antigen se milta hai to wo 'differentiate' hokar Plasma Cell ban jata hai, aur Plasma cell hi antibody (humoral immunity) banata aur chhodta hai. Yani antibody ki asli 'factory' plasma cell hai, jo B-cell se banti hai. Baaki teen ye kaam nahi karte: Basophils histamine chhodte hain, T-lymphocytes cell-mediated immunity (killer/helper) karte hain aur antibody seedha nahi banate, aur Natural killer cells virus-infected/cancer cells ko maarte hain. Exam point: 'Antibody factory = Plasma cell (B-lymphocyte se banti hai)'.

qe: Basophils and tissue mast cells synthesize and release which vasoactive amine during systemic hypersensitivity reactions?
qh: एलर्जी और अतिसंवेदनशीलता प्रतिक्रियाओं के दौरान बेसोफिल और मास्ट कोशिकाओं द्वारा कौन सा रसायन छोड़ा जाता है?
e: Concept: Basophils (blood me) aur Mast cells (tissue me) dono me histamine bhara hota hai. Allergy/hypersensitivity ke waqt ye degranulate hokar Histamine chhodte hain - jaise mosambi ke chhilke se aankh-baundh fule, daane, khujli (urticaria), naak chok, aur asthma me saans phoolna; histamine blood vessels ko failata hai (vasodilation) aur unme se paani nikalne deta hai (isliye sujan). Baaki teen alag padarth hain: Erythropoietin kidney ka hormone (RBC banao), Dopamine ek neurotransmitter, aur Fibrin ek clotting protein. Exam point: 'Allergy/hypersensitivity ka chemical = Histamine (basophils + mast cells)'.

qe: Hemolytic disease of the newborn (Erythroblastosis Fetalis) clinically occurs under which parental-fetal immunological pairing?
qh: गर्भस्थ शिशु में 'एरिथ्रोब्लास्टोसिस फेटेलिस' रोग किस Rh विसंगति के कारण होता है?
o: Rh-positive mother carrying an Rh-negative fetus
Rh-negative mother carrying an Rh-positive fetus (second pregnancy)
Rh-negative mother carrying an Rh-negative fetus
e: Concept: Rh incompatibility wala danger tab hota hai jab Maa Rh-negative ho aur baccha Rh-positive ho (bacche ko Rh-positive father se mila). Pehli pregnancy me problem kam hoti hai, kyunki maa ke blood me abhi anti-Rh antibodies nahi hote; par delivery ke time agar bacche ka Rh-positive blood maa ke blood me chala jaye to maa ki body anti-Rh antibodies bana leti hai. Doosri pregnancy me ye antibodies placenta se ja kar Rh-positive bacche ke RBC ko tod dete hain - isse 'Erythroblastosis Fetalis' (Hemolytic disease of newborn) hoti hai. Baaki teen pairings me ye rog nahi hota. Exam point: 'Rh-negative maa + Rh-positive baccha (2nd pregnancy) = Erythroblastosis fetalis; bachav = Anti-D (RhoGAM) injection'.

qe: Which tendinous cords tether the papillary muscles of ventricular walls to atrioventricular valve leaflets?
qh: हृदय के वाल्वों को मजबूती से पकड़कर रखने वाले और निलय संकुचन के दौरान उन्हें उलटने से रोकने वाले 'हार्ट स्ट्रिंग्स' कहलाते हैं:
e: Concept: Ventricles ke andar chhote-chhote muscle ke dumbe (papillary muscles) hote hain, jinse nikal kar moti rasiyan (tendons) atrioventricular valves ki pattiyon se judti hain - in rasiyon ko Chordae Tendineae kehte hain. Jab ventricles kheenchte hain to ye rasiyan valve ko sahi jagah pakad kar rakhti hain, taaki wo ulta khul kar atria me blood wapas na jaane de (valve inversion rokna). Baaki teen alag structures hain: Pectinate fibers atria ke andar muscle ki jhaliyan, Trabeculae carneae ventricles ki deewar ki andar ki ubhri hui pattiyan, aur Ligamentum arteriosum ek fetal remnant (ductus arteriosus ka). Exam point: 'AV valves ko pakadne wali rasiyan = Chordae tendineae (papillary muscles se judi)'.

qe: In a standard clinical surface Electrocardiogram (ECG), the P-wave designates:
qh: मानक ईसीजी (ECG) में 'P-वेव' हृदय की किस विद्युत गतिविधि को दर्शाती है?
e: Concept: ECG (dhadkan ka electrical graph) me sabse pehle ek chhoti si lehar dikhati hai jise P-wave kehte hain - ye Atria (upar ke chambers) ke depolarization ki symbol hai, yaani atria ka contraction shuru hone ka signal. Baaki teen alag waves hain: Atrioventricular nodal delay P ke baad PR segment me dikhta hai, QRS complex ventricular depolarization hai, aur T-wave ventricular repolarization. Exam point: 'P-wave = Atrial depolarization (fir QRS = ventricular, T = ventricular recovery)'.

qe: The QRS complex on an electrocardiogram tracing reflects:
qh: ईसीजी में 'QRS कॉम्प्लेक्स' किस घटना को इंगित करता है?
e: Concept: ECG me teen lehron ka pattern yaad rakho: P (atria ka signal), QRS complex (ventricles ka signal) aur T (ventricles ka relax). QRS complex sabse bada, tez lehar hoti hai kyunki ventricles bahut bade hote hain aur ek saath kheenchte hain - ye us Electrical activity ko dikhata hai jisse ventricular contraction shuru hoti hai. Baaki teen galat hain: Ventricular diastole me relaxation hokar T-wave hoti hai, Aortic valve ka khulna sound tha na ki electrical, aur atrial repolarization QRS me chhip jati hai. Exam point: 'QRS = ventricular depolarization (contraction ka electrical signal)'.

qe: The T-wave on a normal surface ECG corresponds to:
qh: ईसीजी ग्राफ में 'T-वेव' का संबंध हृदय की किस प्रक्रिया से है?
e: Concept: ECG ki P aur QRS ke baad aati hai T-wave, jo ventricles ke repolarization (recovery) ko dikhati hai - yaani electrical reset hone ka process, jiske baad ventricles relax hote hain aur agli dharkan ki taiyari hoti hai. Baaki teen galat hain: Purkinje activation aur SA node recovery chhote hote hain, aur atrial contraction P-wave se pehle ka kaam hai. Exam point: 'T-wave = ventricular repolarization (relaxation/recovery phase)'.

qe: A resting heart rate chronically exceeding 100 beats per minute in an adult is clinically termed:
qh: वयस्क में विश्राम के समय हृदय गति का 100 बीट प्रति मिनट से अधिक हो जाना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Normal adult ki rest wali dharkan 60-100 per minute hoti hai. Agar ye 100 se upar chali jaye to ise Tachycardia kehte hain (bukhar, ghabrahat, blood loss, thyroid, exercise me normal bhi ho sakta hai). Baaki teen shabd alag hain: Bradycardia = dharkan 60 se kam (khaas kar 50 se neeche), Arrhythmia = dharkan ka rhythm hi galat (tachycardia/bradycardia sab isme aate hain), aur Asystole = dil ka ruk jana (flatline, cardiac arrest). Exam point: '>100 = Tachycardia, <60 = Bradycardia, rhythm galat = Arrhythmia'.

qe: The unique venous system channeling nutrient-dense venous blood from the intestines directly to the liver is the:
qh: आंतों से पोषक तत्वों से भरपूर रक्त को सीधे यकृत (Liver) तक पहुँचाने वाला शिरा तंत्र कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Aanto me khaana paach hone ke baad nutrients (glucose, amino acids) bhare khoon ko liver tak pahunchana zaroori hai, kyunki liver unhe process, store aur poison-free karta hai. Iske liye ek khaas kram hai - aanto se khoon pehle Hepatic Portal Vein me jata hai, jo liver me le jati hai; wahan se liver ki hepatic vein se hokar inferior vena cava me milta hai. Ye 'portal system' kahlata hai kyunki blood do capillary beds (aanto + liver) se hokar guzarta hai. Baaki teen alag systems hain: Pulmonary circuit (lungs), Renal portal, Hypophyseal portal (brain me). Exam point: 'Aanto -> Liver = Hepatic Portal System (ek vein, do capillary beds)'.

qe: Transient, sharp substernal thoracic pain triggered by myocardial ischemia under exertion is diagnosed as:
qh: हृदय की मांसपेशियों में रक्त और ऑक्सीजन की कमी के कारण छाती में होने वाले तीव्र दर्द को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Concept: Angina Pectoris matlab seene me dard - ye tab hota hai jab heart ke muscle ko mehnat (chalna, seedhiyan, ghabrahat) ke waqt oxygen ki zaroorat badh jati hai, par block hui coronary artery wo pura nahi kar pati; isliye dard hota hai jo Aram karne par ~2-5 minute me kam ho jata hai. Ye heart attack se alag hai (wahan artery poora band hoti hai aur damage hamesha rehta hai). Baaki teen alag conditions hain: Cardiac tamponade (heart ke aas-paas fluid), Atheroma (plaque khud), aur Pulmonary embolism (lung me clot). Exam point: 'Exertion ke waqt dard, rest me thik = Angina (nitrate/glycerine se aaram)'.

qe: Atherosclerosis pathologically initiates through which vascular wall alteration?
qh: एथेरोस्क्लेरोसिस (धमनी काठिन्य) का प्राथमिक कारण धमनियों की आंतरिक परत में किसका जमाव होना है?
o: Deposition of lipids and cholesterol plaques in the tunica intima
Excessive thinning of the tunica adventitia
e: Concept: Atherosclerosis ek 'dheere-dheere artery ki deewar me jama hone wali' bimari hai - isme LDL cholesterol aur lipids blood vessel ki sabse andar wali patli parat (tunica intima) me ghus kar plaque (athroma) banate hain; plaque badhta hai ya phat jata hai to artery block ho jati hai (heart attack/stroke). Baaki teen galat hai: Capillary sphincter rupture, heart valves girna, aur tunica adventitia patli hona atherosclerosis ka mechanism nahi. Exam point: 'Atherosclerosis = tunica intima me lipid/cholesterol plaque'.

qe: The primary glycoprotein hormone stimulating erythroid progenitor proliferation in bone marrow is:
qh: लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं (RBC) के निर्माण (Erythropoiesis) को प्रेरित करने वाला मुख्य हार्मोन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: RBC ki production ko 'erythropoiesis' kehte hain aur iska mukhya driver hormone Erythropoietin (EPO) hai, jo kidney me (aur thoda liver me) banta hai. Jab blood me oxygen kam hoti hai (high altitude, anaemia, blood loss), kidney EPO chhodti hai, jo bone marrow ko RBC banane ka signal deta hai. Isi wajah se kidney patient me anaemia hoti hai aur khel me EPO doping hoti hai. Baaki teen alag hormones hain: Gastrin pet me acid, Aldosterone sodium-potassium balance, aur Thyroxine metabolism. Exam point: 'RBC banane ka hormone = Erythropoietin (kidney se)'.

qe: Which enzyme converts soluble plasma Fibrinogen into insoluble Fibrin polymer threads during clotting?
qh: रक्त का थक्का जमने के दौरान घुलनशील फाइब्रिनोजेन को अघुलनशील फाइब्रिन जाली में बदलने वाला एंजाइम कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Khoon jamne ki antim chain reaction me ek enzyme Thrombin kaam karta hai - ye soluble fibrinogen (plasma protein) ko kaatkar insoluble Fibrin threads bana deta hai, aur ye threads jaal ki tarah platelets ko pakadkar cloth (clot) banate hain; isliye ise 'fibrinogen se fibrin' ka converter kehte hain. Baaki teen enzymes kaam nahi karte: Fibrinogen to kaccha material hai (enzyme nahi), Plasmin clot todta hai (ulta kaam), aur Amylase/Pepsin digestion ke enzymes hain. Exam point: 'Fibrinogen -> Fibrin = Thrombin', 'Fibrin clot todna = Plasmin'.

qe: Classic 'Royal Disease' (Hemophilia A) is caused by an X-linked recessive genetic deficiency of which clotting protein?
qh: 'शाही बीमारी' (हीमोफिलिया A) रक्त स्कंदन के किस कारक की आनुवंशिक कमी के कारण होती है?
e: Concept: Hemophilia ek X-linked recessive bimari hai (maa carrier, beta affected), jisme khaas clotting factor nahi banta isliye chhoti chot se bhi khoon behne lagta hai aur jod me dard-sujan hoti hai. Iska sabse common type Hemophilia A hai, jo Factor VIII (antihemophilic factor) ki kami se hota hai; Hemophilia B (Christmas disease) me Factor IX kam hota hai. Isi bimari ki wajah se Queen Victoria ke vansh ke rajkumar bimar hote the, isliye ise 'Royal Disease' kehte hain. Baaki teen factors se ye rog nahi hota. Exam point: 'Hemophilia A = Factor VIII ki kami (X-linked)', 'Hemophilia B = Factor IX'.

qe: What is the primary role of the fibrinolytic serine protease 'Plasmin' in the cardiovascular system?
qh: रक्त में प्लास्मिन (Plasmin) एंजाइम का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
o: Lysis and dissolution of intravascular fibrin blood clots
e: Concept: Khoon jam jane ke baad usko todne ka kaam bhi zaroori hai, warna nali hamesha ke liye band ho jayegi. Ye kaam Plasmin karta hai - ye ek fibrinolytic enzyme hai jo fibrin web (clot) ko todkar clot ghula deta hai; clinic me iska upyog (jaise alteplase) heart attack/stroke me blood ko pighlane ke liye hota hai. Baaki teen kaam ulta hain: Platelets ko activate karna aur vasoconstriction clotting badhane wale hain, aur prothrombin complex banana clotting ka hissa hai. Exam point: 'Clot ko todna = Plasmin (fibrinolysis)', 'clot banana = thrombin'.

qe: The specialized autonomic conductive fibers distributing electrical depolarization throughout ventricular myocardium are:
qh: निलय की मांसपेशियों में विद्युत आवेगों को सबसे तेज गति से प्रसारित करने वाले विशिष्ट फाइबर क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Concept: Heart ke ventricles me signal bhejne ke liye ek khaas electrical network hota hai: AV node se Bundle of His, usse left-right bundles, aur phir poori ventricular muscle ki andar ki deewar me phaili hui conductive fibres - inhe Purkinje Fibers kehte hain. Ye depolarization ko bahut tez (bada area me ek saath) pahunchate hain, taaki poora ventricle ek saath kheenchkar jabardast dhakka de. Baaki teen fibres is kaamki nahi hain: Collagen type I support ka protein, Sharpey's fibers haddi me tendon/ligament ke fibres, aur elastic microfilaments lachakdar connective tissue. Exam point: 'Ventricles me signal pahunchane wale = Purkinje fibers'.

qe: The interatrial shunt present in the developing fetal heart allowing blood to bypass pulmonary circuits is the:
qh: भ्रूण के हृदय में फेफड़ों को दरकिनार करते हुए दाएं अलिंद से बाएं अलिंद में रक्त ले जाने वाला छिद्र क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Fetus ke lungs oxygen use nahi karte (kyunki wo paani me bhare hote hain), to uske khoon ko lungs bypass karke seedha left atrium me pahunchane ka intezaam chahiye - ye kaam Foramen Ovale (ek chhed/window) karta hai, jo right aur left atria ke beech hota hai. Janam ke baad breathing shuru hote hi ye band ho jata hai aur 'fossa ovalis' ban jata hai. Baaki teen alag shunts hain: Ductus arteriosus (pulmonary artery se aorta), Ductus venosus (umbilical vein se IVC), aur Canal of Schlemm aankh me hota hai (fetus ka nahi). Exam point: 'Fetal shunt: Foramen ovale = atria ke beech (lungs bypass)'.

qe: Which fetal vascular shunt connects the pulmonary arterial trunk directly to the aortic arch?
qh: भ्रूण में फुफ्फुस धमनी को सीधे महाधमनी (Aorta) से जोड़ने वाली वाहिका क्या कहलाती है जो जन्म के बाद बंद हो जाती है?
e: Concept: Fetus ke lungs me kaam nahi hota, isliye right ventricle ka kaafi khoon ek bade pipe (vessel) ke through seedha aorta me chala jata hai - is pipe ko Ductus Arteriosus kehte hain (pulmonary artery trunk ko aortic arch se jodta hai), jisse blood lungs bypass karke poori body me pahunch jata hai. Janam ke baad ye band hokar 'Ligamentum arteriosum' ban jata hai. Baaki teen ye kaam nahi karte: Urachus fetal bladder se nikalta hai, Umbilical vein placenta se oxygen-khoon laati hai, aur Ligamentum teres liver ka ek remnant hai. Exam point: 'Pulmonary artery -> Aorta = Ductus arteriosus'.

qe: The 'Bohr Effect' in respiratory physiology explains how hemoglobin's affinity for oxygen decreases in the presence of:
qh: श्वसन शरीर क्रिया विज्ञान में 'बोहर प्रभाव' (Bohr Effect) के अनुसार हीमोग्लोबिन की ऑक्सीजन बंधन क्षमता कब घटती है?
o: Elevated pCO2 and hydrogen ion concentration (acidity)
e: Concept: Bohr Effect kehta hai ki jahan CO2 aur acidity (H+) zyada ho, wahan haemoglobin ki oxygen se mohabbat kam ho jati hai - isliye wo oxygen chhod deta hai. Ye poori body ke liye faaydemand hai, kyunki mehnet karne wale tissue me CO2/acid zyada hoti hai aur use oxygen chahiye; isi wajah se CO2 lung tak chlne par wahan acidity kam hokar haemoglobin dobara oxygen grab kar leta hai. Baaki teen galat hai: thanda/alkaline temperature oxygen ka bonding badhata hai (chhoot nahi), nitrogen/hyperbaric aur high altitude ka isse alag mechanism hai. Exam point: 'Bohr effect = zyada CO2/H+ (acid) par Haemoglobin ka O2 chhod dena'.

qe: Which endogenous gas synthesized by endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS) acts as the primary paracrine vasodilator?
qh: रक्त वाहिकाओं को शिथिल (चौड़ा) कर रक्तचाप कम करने वाला एंडोथीलियम द्वारा उत्पादित मुख्य रासायनिक यौगिक कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Blood vessel ki endothelium (andar ki parat) me ek enzyme eNOS hota hai jo L-arginine se Nitric Oxide (NO) gas banata hai. NO ek paracrine vasodilator hai - ye blood vessel ki muscle ko dheela karke faila deta hai, jisse blood flow badhta hai aur BP kam rehta hai. Isi mechanism par nitroglycerin (angina me) aur sildenafil jaise drugs kaam karte hain. Baaki teen gases ye kaam nahi karti: Nitrogen dioxide ek pradushak hai, Hydrogen sulfide aur Carbon monoxide body ke kuch signal me hote hain par primary vasodilator nahi. Exam point: 'Endothelium ka primary vasodilator = Nitric Oxide (NO)'.

qe: What is the calculated 'Pulse Pressure' in an individual with a normotensive blood pressure of 120/80 mmHg?
qh: 120/80 mmHg रक्तचाप वाले व्यक्ति का 'पल्स प्रेशर' (Pulse Pressure) कितना होगा?
e: Concept: BP ki upar wali sankhya systolic (dil jab kheenchta hai) aur neeche wali diastolic (dil jab relax hota hai) hoti hai; in dono ka antar 'Pulse Pressure' kehlata hai. Yahan 120 - 80 = 40 mmHg, jo normal (30-50 mmHg) range me hai. Baaki teen numbers alag cheezein batate hain: 1.5 bhi nahi, 93 mean arterial pressure (MAP) ke kareeb hai, aur 200 to bahut zyada hai. Exam point: 'Pulse pressure = systolic - diastolic (~40 mmHg normal)'.

qe: Severe systemic tissue hypoperfusion resulting from catastrophic acute hemorrhage is clinically classified as:
qh: अत्यधिक रक्तस्राव या तरल की भारी कमी के कारण उत्पन्न होने वाले आपातकालीन शॉक को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Shock ka matlab hai body ke tissue ko blood/oxygen na pahunchna. Jab bahut zyada khoon beh jata hai (accident, goli/khoon wali injury) to blood volume kam ho jata hai aur BP gir jata hai - is shock ko Hypovolemic shock kehte hain (hypo = kam, volemic = volume). Iska ilaaj jaldi IV fluid/blood dena hota hai. Baaki teen alag types ke shock hain: Cardiogenic (heart pump fail), Neurogenic (nerve injury se vessels failadna), aur Septic (infection se). Exam point: 'Khoon ki kami = Hypovolemic shock'.

qe: Which enzyme abundantly contained in erythrocytes catalyzes the rapid reversible hydration of carbon dioxide into bicarbonate?
qh: लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं में CO2 को बाइकार्बोनेट आयनों में बदलने की क्रिया को तेज करने वाला एंजाइम कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Shakkar/energy banana ke baad CO2 paida hota hai; usko blood se lung tak dhaane ke liye RBC me ek enzyme Carbonanhydrase hota hai jo CO2 ko paani ke saath milakar Bicarbonate (HCO3-) aur hydrogen ions me badal deta hai (reversible reaction) - is se CO2 khoon me ghul kar aasani se travel karta hai aur lungs me wapas CO2 ban jata hai. Ise yaad rakho: ye RBC me sabse zyada maatra me milne wale enzymes me se hai. Baaki teen enzymes alag kaam karte hain: Cytochrome c oxidase respiration ki chain me, Lactate dehydrogenase anaerobic metabolism me, aur Catalase H2O2 todta hai. Exam point: 'CO2 + H2O <-> HCO3- = Carbonic anhydrase (RBC me)'.

qe: The 'Bombay Blood Group' (hh phenotype) is an extraordinarily rare genetic blood type characterized by the absence of:
qh: अत्यंत दुर्लभ 'बॉम्बे ब्लड ग्रुप' (Bombay Blood Group) में किस बुनियादी एंटीजन का अभाव होता है?
e: Concept: Bombay Blood Group (hh phenotype) ek bahut hi rare blood group hai (India me sabse pehle Mumbai me mila, isliye naam) - isme person ke RBC par H-antigen bhi nahi hota, jo baaki sabhi ABO groups ke antigens (A, B, AB, O) banane ki neev hai. Isliye inhe ABO ka koi bhi blood nahi chad sakta (sirf doosre Bombay group wale ka) - aur ye log sabhi ke liye universal donor ho sakte hain. Baaki teen cheezein isme nahi hoti: platelet integrin, Rh factor, aur albumin fraction. Exam point: 'Bombay blood group = H-antigen ki kami (sabse rare, apna hi blood bank chahiye)'.

qe: The Frank-Starling Law of the Heart establishes an intrinsic relationship between:
qh: हृदय का 'फ्रैंक-स्टारलिंग नियम' (Frank-Starling Law) मुख्य रूप से किनके बीच संबंध दर्शाता है?
o: End-diastolic ventricular stretching (preload) and stroke volume force
e: Concept: Frank-Starling Law heart ka apna self-regulating niyam hai: agar ventricle me khoon zyada bharkar uski deewar zyada khinch jati hai (stretching/preload badhta hai), to wo agle dhakke me zyada force se zyada khoon pump karega - kyunki actin-myosin ka overlap best ho jata hai aur calcium sensitivity badh jati hai. Yehi wajah hai ki exercise me pehle stroke volume badhta hai, dharkan baad me. Baaki teen relationships isme nahi aate: aortic resistance, viscosity/laminar flow aur vagal tone doosre concepts hain. Exam point: 'Frank-Starling = zyada filling (preload) -> zyada stroke volume'.

qe: The vascular micro-channels supplying metabolic perfusion to the muscular tunics of large elastic arteries are:
qh: महाधमनी जैसी बड़ी और मोटी रक्त वाहिकाओं की दीवारों को रक्त की आपूर्ति करने वाली सूक्ष्म वाहिकाएं क्या कहलाती हैं?
e: Concept: Badi arteries ki deewar itni moti hoti hai ki bahar se aane wala khoon diffusion se uske andar ke hisse tak nahi pahunch sakta - isliye unki deewar me hi chhoti-chhoti khoon ki naliyan hoti hain, jinhe Vasa Vasorum (vessels of the vessels) kehte hain; ye tunica media aur adventitia ko khana-oxygen deti hain. Baaki teen alag structures hain: Canaliculi haddi ke cells ke chhote channels, Sinusoids liver/bone marrow ki chaudi capillaries, aur Haversian canals haddi ke andar ke channels. Exam point: 'Bade vessels ki deewar ki apni naliyan = Vasa vasorum'.

qe: Which heart chamber receives coronary venous return directly from the cardiac myocardium via the coronary sinus?
qh: हृदय की मांसपेशियों का ऑक्सीजन-रहित रक्त कोरोनरी साइनस के माध्यम से किस कक्ष में गिरता है?
e: Concept: Heart ke muscle ko jo khoon milta hai, wo coronary veins me ikattha hota hai aur wahan se ek badi vein - Coronary Sinus - ke through seedha Right Atrium me aata hai (inferior vena cava ke paas khulta hai). Isliye oxygen khatam kar chuka ye blood pehle right atrium me jaata hai, phir right ventricle, lungs... yaani dobara puri journey. Baaki teen chambers yahan receive nahi karte: Left Atrium, Left Ventricle aur Right Ventricle me ye sinus nahi khulta. Exam point: 'Coronary sinus = Right Atrium me khulta hai'.

qe: A localized, pathological, balloon-like dilation of an arterial vessel wall weakened by degeneration is an:
qh: कमजोर धमनी की दीवार में उभार या गुब्बारे जैसी थैली बनने की खतरनाक स्थिति को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Aneurysm matlab blood vessel ki kamzor hui deewar ka balloon ki tarah fool jana (localized dilation) - khaas kar aorta me. Ye dheere-dheere badhta hai aur agar phat jaye (rupture) to zyada tar maut ho jati hai. Iske risk factors: BP, smoking, age aur Umar se jude connective tissue kamzori. Baaki teen alag conditions hain: Embolism = traveling clot jo nali band kare, Phlebitis = vein ki sujan, aur Infarction = tissue ka mar jana (blockage se). Exam point: 'Artery ki deewar ka balloon jaisa foolna = Aneurysm (rupture khatarnak)'.

qe: Which reptile represents an evolutionary exception by exhibiting a fully partitioned Four-Chambered heart?
qh: कौन सा सरीसृप (Reptile) एक अपवाद है और स्तनधारियों की तरह 4-कक्षीय (Four-chambered) हृदय रखता है?
e: Concept: Machhli (fish) me 2 chambers, amphibian me 3, reptile me usually 3 (incomplete 4), aur pakshi-mammal me 4 chambers hote hain. Is niyam ka ek apvaad Crocodile (magarmachh) hai - isme dil poori tarah 4 chambers wala hota hai (do atria, do ventricles), ek khaas Foramen of Panizza ke saath. Baaki teen reptiles 3-chamber wale ya incomplete hain: Komodo dragon, Python aur chameleon. Exam point: 'Reptiles me 4-chamber heart ka apvaad = Crocodile'.

qe: The mechanical compression of the heart caused by pathological fluid accumulation inside the pericardial cavity is:
qh: पेरीकार्डियल थैली में अत्यधिक द्रव या रक्त भर जाने से हृदय पर दबाव पड़ने की आपातकालीन स्थिति कहलाती है:
e: Concept: Pericardial cavity heart ki thaili ke andar ek chhoti si jaga hoti hai jisme normally thoda fluid (10-50 ml) hota hai, jo heart ko ghisne se bachata hai. Agar wahan khoon, pus ya fluid tezi se bhar jaye (accident, heart surgery, infection), to bahari dabav badh kar heart ko daba deta hai - dharkan meblood aana (filling) ruk jata hai, BP gir jata hai aur jaldi maut ho sakti hai. Is condition ko Cardiac Tamponade kehte hain; isliye iska foran ilaaj pericardium ko needle se kholna (pericardiocentesis) hota hai. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Cardiomyopathy (heart muscle ki bimari), Myocarditis (muscle ki sujan) aur Patent Ductus (fetal nali band na hona). Exam point: 'Pericardial fluid se heart ka dabna = Cardiac tamponade (Beck's triad)'.

qe: Which class of circulating human immunoglobulins can cross the placental barrier to confer passive humoral immunity?
qh: मानव शरीर की कौन सी एंटीबॉडी (Immunoglobulin) प्लेसेंटा को पार करके गर्भस्थ शिशु को प्रतिरक्षा प्रदान कर सकती है?
e: Concept: Immunoglobulins (antibodies) ke 5 types hote hain - IgG, IgM, IgA, IgE, IgD. Inmein sirf IgG hi itna chhota hai ki placenta ki membrane se guzar kar fetus tak pahunch sakta hai, isliye maa ki immune power bacche ko jab tak wo khud antibodies bana na paye (paidaish ke pehle 6 mahine tak) protection deti hai. Baaki teen placenta cross nahi karte: IgM sabse bada molecule hai (sirf blood me rehta hai), IgA doodh aur aanton me hota hai, aur IgE allergy/parasites se juda hai. Exam point: 'Placenta cross karne wala antibody = IgG (passive immunity bacche ko)'.

qe: In an acute ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction (STEMI), what does ST elevation on ECG represent?
qh: ईसीजी में 'ST-सेगमेंट का बढ़ना' (ST Elevation) किस गंभीर स्थिति का नैदानिक संकेत है?
o: Acute transmural myocardial ischemia and injury (Heart Attack)
e: Concept: STEMI (ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction) ek heart attack hai jisme coronary artery ka poora block hone se heart muscle ka ek poora hissa (transmural = poori deewar me) khoon se kat jata hai (ischemia + injury) aur marne lagta hai. ECG me khaas ST segment upar uth jaata hai, isi se naam STEMI. Ye medical emergency hai - jitna jaldi block khola jaye (angioplasty/thrombolysis) utna kam nuksaan. Baaki teen bilkul alag hain: iron deficiency anaemia, normal sinus rhythm (tohta), aur chronic low BP. Exam point: 'ST elevation ECG = Heart attack (STEMI) = transmural infarct'.

qe: In Sickle Cell Anemia, which single amino acid substitution occurs at position 6 of the beta-globin polypeptide chain?
qh: सिकल सेल एनीमिया में हीमोग्लोबिन की बीटा श्रृंखला में 6वें स्थान पर किस अमीनो एसिड का प्रतिस्थापन होता है?
o: Glutamic acid is replaced by Valine
Glutamic acid is replaced by Histidine
e: Concept: Sickle Cell Anemia ek genetic (autosomal recessive) bimari hai jisme beta-globin chain ke 6th position par ek single amino acid badal jata hai - Glutamic acid (charged, achha) ki jagah Valine (neutral, chipchipa) aa jata hai. Isi ek badlaav se haemoglobin ka shape bigadkar RBC ko hathyar (sickle) jaisa ban jata hai, jo oxygen kam hone par kat liya jata hai, naliyan band karta hai, dard aur haemolysis karta hai. Baaki teen substitutions isme nahi hoti (wo hypothetical ya doosre liver ke disorders se hain). Exam point: 'Sickle cell = beta-globin ke 6th position par Glu -> Val (single point mutation)'.

qe: Which specialized lymphatic capillaries located within intestinal villi absorb long-chain dietary lipids and chylomicrons?
qh: आंत के रसांकुरों (Villi) में वसा के अवशोषण के लिए जिम्मेदार विशेष लसिका वाहिकाएं क्या कहलाती हैं?
e: Concept: Chhoti aant ke villi ke andar khaas lymphatic naliyan hoti hain jinhe Lacteals kehte hain - badi (long-chain) fat ke paachan se bane chylomicrons aur lipid yehi absorb karte hain aur lymph ke through subclavian vein me pahun jaate hain. Isi wajah se fat ka absorption blood ke bajaye lymph se hota hai (aur aant ka lymph safed doodhiya dikhta hai). Baaki teen ye kaam nahi karte: Crypts of Lieberkuhn aant ki glands (enzymes banati hain), Venules chhoti veins, aur Sinusoids liver/bone marrow ki khoon-nahaliyan. Exam point: 'Fat absorption = Lacteals (lymphatic capillaries of villi)'.

qe: A mobile intravascular mass (thrombus, air bubble, or fat globule) carried in circulation that impacts a downstream vessel is an:
qh: रक्त प्रवाह में तैरने वाला थक्का या बाहरी पदार्थ जो आगे जाकर किसी संकीर्ण वाहिका को अवरुद्ध कर देता है, क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Khoon ke andar tairta hua koi bhi cheez jo nali me ghoom kar aage kahin ja kar atak jaye, use Embolus kehte hain - ye clot ke tukde se bhi ban sakta hai (thrombus ka bikharna), hawa ke bulle se (air embolism), fat globule se (haddi fracture ke baad), ya amniotic fluid se. Ye jahan atakta hai wahan ka tissue khoon se kat jata hai. Baaki teen shabd alag hain: Aneurysm = nali ka foolna, Ischemia = khoon ka kam pahunchana, aur Stenosis = nali ka patla hona. Exam point: 'Traveling clot/mass = Embolus', 'wahin bana rukne wala = Thrombus'.

qe: In which anatomical vascular segment is the linear velocity of blood flow at its lowest physiological point?
qh: पोषक तत्वों और गैसों के उचित आदान-प्रदान के लिए रक्त प्रवाह की गति सबसे धीमी किस वाहिका में होती है?
e: Concept: Blood ki linear velocity (speed) nali ke kul area par nirbhar karti hai - jahan area chhota, wahan speed zyada (aorta me ~40 cm/s), aur jahan area sabse bada ho wahan speed sabse kam. Capillaries chhoti hoti hain par unki sankhya crore me hoti hai, isliye unka total cross-section area aorta se lagbhag 1000 guna bada hota hai - isliye capillary me blood sabse dheere (lagbhag 0.03 cm/s ~ 1 mm/s) chalta hai. Yahi dheemapan gas/nutrient exchange ke liye zaroori hai (time milta hai). Baaki teen me speed zyada hoti hai: Aorta sabse tez, muscular arteries medium, aur inferior vena cava ke bhi capillary se zyada. Exam point: 'Blood flow sabse dheema = Capillaries (exchange ke liye zaroori)'.

qe: Which clinical pharmacologic agent serves as the direct chemical antidote to neutralize unfractionated Heparin overdose?
qh: अस्पतालों में हेपेरिन (Heparin) के अत्यधिक प्रभाव को बेअसर करने के लिए किस मारक (Antidote) का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Heparin ek anticoagulant hai jo blood ko bahut patla kar deta hai (surgery, dialysis me use hota hai), par iski overdosage se bleeding ho sakti hai - iska koi natural antidote nahi hai, isliye ek chemical antidote use hota hai: Protamine Sulfate. Ye positively charged protein hai jo negatively charged heparin se judkar uski activity neutral kar deta hai. Baaki teen alag antidotes hain: Vitamin K warfarin (coumadin) ka antidote hai, Warfarin khud ek anticoagulant hai, aur Tranexamic Acid ek antifibrinolytic (clot todne rokne wala) hai. Exam point: 'Heparin overdose ka antidote = Protamine sulfate', 'Warfarin overdose = Vitamin K'.
